trust_decision.summary: The server-supplied `link` response header is treated as untrusted input to a regex that pulls out the deprecation URL. This happens only when a `deprecation` header is present, in fetchWrapper.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the regex in fetchWrapper. It is the only regex in src/.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API request(route, options), via withDefaults newApi (src/index.ts:5, src/with-defaults.ts:23, :30-31)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None applies. There is one regex on one input, and no other parser of `link` exists in src/. The bumps to @octokit/endpoint and @octokit/request-error (fix.diff:242-245) fix their own advisories in other repos.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The deprecation warning must still extract the deprecation URL from a multi-entry Link header and still warn when no link is present. An over-broad fix that drops link parsing or the warning would break this.

O6_input_shapes: Link header string with many '<' characters and no closing '> ; rel="deprecation"' (fix.diff:141)

O7_producer.where: Response headers are copied directly from fetchResponse.headers at src/fetch-wrapper.ts:85-87

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Parse the `sunset` header or a `rel="alternate"` link with a similar unanchored [^>]+ regex.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The warning already interpolates sunset and the alternate link appears in the test fixtures (test/request.test.ts:899), so a maintainer could plausibly parse them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add a hand-written regex for pagination Link or charset parsing in getResponseData.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Content-type is parsed here today through safeParse at src/fetch-wrapper.ts:158, and a homegrown regex replacement is plausible.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333), polynomial backtracking in an unanchored regex over a response header

O10_build.project_tests: test/request.test.ts:886-940 and test/request-native-fetch.test.ts:968-1030 cover the deprecation warning with a mocked fetch (fetch-mock). The published ReDoS test uses real fetch to api.github.com (fix.diff:138-152), so a hidden test should use a mocked fetch instead.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change [^>]+ to [^<>]+, or cap the length of the link header before matching. Both are correct, so there is no scope trap.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix also bumps @octokit/endpoint and @octokit/request-error (fix.diff:242-245), which carry their own ReDoS advisories in other repositories. Not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured. The source is 6 small files in src/, so it is assumed well under 5 MB.
Recall risk is estimated. Three sibling octokit ReDoS CVEs were published the same day, which makes the class widely written up.
